title: Be the test suite
prompt: The provided `average` has a real logic bug (integer division truncates). Write `main` that acts as a test suite: print one line per case, `PASS`/`FAIL name` per check, covering (1) average({1,2}) == 1.5, (2) average({5}) == 5.0, (3) average throws IllegalArgumentException for an empty array. Run it, watch case 1 FAIL, then fix `average` (cast before dividing) so all three print PASS.

tests.name: the fixed average is exact
tests.hint: Cast BEFORE dividing: sum / (double) scores.length keeps the fraction.

tests.name: empty input still throws
tests.hint: Keep the guard as-is - the fix is the division, not the guard.
